FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Creative Canvas Studio, we specialize in providing a welcoming and inspiring environment for artists and art enthusiasts to explore their creativity. Our operations focus on artistic activities such as painting, drawing, digital art, and textile crafts. We adhere to strict safety protocols and utilize only non-toxic, low-toxicity materials, ensuring all art supplies are stored correctly with clear documentation of safe handling procedures. 

Our studio is equipped with comprehensive fire detection and suppression systems, including smoke alarms and sprinklers, to protect our workspace and priceless artwork. We prioritize secure storage for valuable tools and customer information while implementing robust cybersecurity measures for online sales. 

In addition to our studio space, we offer public workshops and classes, accompanied by established safety protocols and participant waivers. We comply fully with local zoning, health, and safety regulations to maintain a legal and safe operation for our staff and visitors. Our dedication to quality and safety allows us to create and foster a positive artistic community.
